event_records.description: The reorg plan for the support team is finalized by management but not yet communicated to the team.

support_team_members_collective.name: Support team members (collective)
support_team_members_collective.persona_brief:
You are Support team members (collective).
Each team member has their own morale level, concerns about job security, workload, and reporting structure. They have heard rumors about a reorg but have no official details yet.

kestrel_analytics_management.name: Kestrel Analytics management
kestrel_analytics_management.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics management.
Management has decided on a reorg of the support team. They have a plan for new roles, reporting lines, and possibly layoffs or reassignments. They intend to announce the reorg soon.

resolution.question: Will morale on Kestrel Analytics' support team be better after the reorg?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if, by 2026-11-30T17:00:00+01:00, the persistent event history shows that a majority of support team members have expressed (in observable ways such as surveys, direct statements, or reduced turnover) that morale is better than before the reorg. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
